TanStack Start server route handlers.description:
Answer HTTP requests from a route file. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router and a TanStack Start server build.

在路由文件中直接响应 HTTP 请求；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute，以及 TanStack Start 的服务端构建。

TanStack Start server route with params.description:
Answer several HTTP methods for one path, reading its dynamic segment from params. Requires createFileRoute from @tanstack/react-router and a TanStack Start server build.

为同一路径响应多种 HTTP 方法，并从 params 读取动态段；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createFileRoute，以及 TanStack Start 的服务端构建。

TanStack Start server entry.description:
Own the server entry so every request can be inspected before the default handler runs. Requires the default export and createServerEntry from @tanstack/react-start/server-entry.

接管服务端入口，使每个请求在交给默认 handler 前都可被检视；需要 @tanstack/react-start/server-entry 的默认导出与 createServerEntry。
